messages:
incident-bot: [PAGE] S2 - embeddings tail latency · eu-prod-emb-1 · affected: Dedicated customers (~3% of requests) · pager at 2026-03-15T14:00Z
DevOps Oncall: I'm on call. investigating. can someone confirm customer impact? @sarah.m @mike.k
sarah.m: seeing 95th/99th spikes from ~120ms -> 1.2s across some hosts, looks correlated with large batch warmups. customers report timeouts in webhooks.
mike.k: confirming, one customer (acme-inc) saw degraded UX on search. no 5xxs, just timeouts in client-side retries. route-level SLOs briefly breached.
DevOps Oncall: immediate mitigation: scale emb pool + reduce max_batch_size for that model. pushing a quick rollout to eu-prod-emb-1 now.
leah.t: note — autoscaler didn't spin up extra nodes fast enough due to quota backoff. opened quick ticket to bump burst capacity for the pool.
priya.r: any config we can flip quickly that reduces latency without big cost? thought: turn on prefix-KV caching for that customer route (they have stable repeated prefixes).
DevOps Oncall: good idea. applying prefix-KV cache opt-in for route /v1/embeddings/acme via console now. rollout id: rb-197246-01
DevOps Oncall: rollout applied, dropping max_batch_size to 8 for that model and enabling prefix cache. observing tail latency in logs.
mike.k: monitoring dashboard shows 99th down to ~300ms after changes. looks promising. still some hosts warming.
incident-bot: Event timeline appended: initial spike 14:00Z, mitigation applied 14:07Z, partial recovery 14:12Z.
sarah.m: ok can we capture action items + owners before we close this? need postmortem and remediation plan.
DevOps Oncall: agreed. creating post-incident followup. propose a 1-hour postmortem tomorrow 2026-03-16 15:00Z. who can attend?
priya.r: I can take lead on the postmortem and own the write-up. I'll schedule and add notes.
mike.k: I'll own the immediate remediation task to make autoscaler more responsive (owner: mike.k, estimate: 2 days).
leah.t: I'll own the capacity/burst config change with infra (owner: leah.t, estimate: 1 day).
sarah.m: action: add a canary rule to detect sudden batch-size spike for embedding models (owner: sarah.m, estimate: 3 days). ties to Q2 reliability epic.
DevOps Oncall: creating tracker ticket now. jira-bot: Creating ticket...
jira-bot: Ticket created: INF-8421 — "Embeddings tail latency: autoscaler responsiveness and batching mitigations" (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8421)
priya.r: other action: add a regression test in Optimize harness to catch this workload shape (owner: priya.r, estimate: 4 days, links to optimize/qa).
DevOps Oncall: summarizing priorities (severity-based):
- P0/P1: immediate customer impact handled — already mitigated via cache + scale.
- P2: autoscaler responsiveness (mike.k) — Medium severity for predictable throughput, high-priority for next sprint.
- P3: canary detection + regression tests (sarah.m / priya.r) — tie to Q2 reliability epic.
- Low: documentation + runbook updates (owner: leah.t)
leah.t: I'll update runbooks after infra changes. estimate 0.5 day.
sarah.m: question — do we want permanent prefix-KV opt-in for acme? or make it route-scoped? prefer route-scoped, plus a rollout plan.
priya.r: route-scoped with an annotation in Console + a small A/B rollout to verify quality impact. add to INF-8421 subtask.
DevOps Oncall: scheduling postmortem: created calendar invite for 2026-03-16 15:00Z, link in ticket. priy a, mike, leah and product engineering invited.
incident-bot: Postmortem checklist added to ticket: timeline, impact (customers/dev), root cause hypothesis (batch warmup + autoscaler lag), mitigation timeline, action items with owners.
mike.k: quick log snippet from one affected host for reference:
```
[14:01:08] model-infer: batch_size=64 -> queue_wait=420ms -> kv-miss spike
[14:02:00] autoscaler: scale_decision=blocked (quota_backoff)
[14:07:12] config: max_batch_size=8 deployed
```
priya.r: nice. for the postmortem I'll include perf traces and sample request/response. will also run replay tests against optimize harness.
sarah.m: prioritization ask for planning: move autoscaler responsiveness work into next sprint as part of Q2 reliability epic and mark as P2. that will be our tie-in to quarterly planning.
DevOps Oncall: agreed. final checklist before close: confirm INF-8421 has subtasks for (1) autoscaler responsiveness, (2) route-canary + detection, (3) regression tests, (4) runbook + docs, (5) customer outreach note (product).
leah.t: i'll draft a short customer note for acme summarizing outage + mitigation & ask for any residual issues. owner: product eng (leah.t) estimate: 0.5 day.
priya.r: closing notes: we'll run a replay tomorrow to validate fixes post-deploy and include results in the postmortem.
DevOps Oncall: closing pager — monitoring windows show stable latency for 30m after mitigation. marking incident as resolved. thanks all. :thumbsup:"
